name: Computerkick Content Fresh
author: Computerkick

sections.description:
Content Fresh adds a dashboard widget and optional welcome panel replacement that highlights content older than your review window. Configure defaults and included post types, or override the policy per post.

The free version supports standard Posts and Pages. Content Fresh Plus unlocks support for custom post types. Media Library support is planned for version 0.2.0+ as a Plus feature.

Features

  • Free: review workflow for Posts and Pages
  • Plus: review workflow for custom post types
  • Dashboard list of flagged content older than the review window
  • Per-post policy overrides with configurable defaults
  • Optional replacement for the default WordPress welcome panel
  • Uninstall cleanup of stored options and post meta
  • Translation-ready

Roadmap / Planned Features

0.2.0

  • Plus: Media Library support
  • Plus: AI-assisted post refresh tools
  • Plus: bulk review tools for dismissing, snoozing, and re-checking flagged items
  • Plus: editorial notes and review ownership
  • Optional email digest / summary reporting for stale content
  • Improved UI, settings organization, and reporting views
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/computerkick-content-fresh/ or install it via the Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to Settings > Content Fresh to configure the default review window, included post types, max items, and welcome panel replacement.
sections.faq:
How do I change the post types shown?

In Settings > Content Fresh, check the post types you want under “Included post types.”

What is included in free vs Plus?

Free includes Posts and Pages. Plus unlocks custom post type support.

Does this support Media Library items?

Not yet. Media support is planned for version 0.2.0+ as a Plus feature.

How do I change the review window?

Set the “Default review policy (days)” value in Settings > Content Fresh. You can also override it per post in the metabox.

Is there a minimum policy window?

Yes. The minimum review policy window is 7 days for both the site default and per-post overrides.

How do I turn off the welcome panel replacement?

Uncheck “Dashboard welcome panel” in Settings > Content Fresh.

What happens on uninstall?

The plugin deletes its settings option and the per-post policy meta.

0.1.10

  • Verify compatibility with WordPress 7.0.

0.1.9

  • Clean up the renamed build and bootstrap configuration for Computerkick Content Fresh.
  • Align Freemius integration settings with the new product slug and Plus branding.

0.1.8

  • Rename the plugin to Computerkick Content Fresh with the new WordPress.org slug and text domain.
  • Refactor global identifiers to the ckcf_ / CKCF_ prefix.
  • Update packaging so release zips build with the new plugin folder names.

0.1.7

  • Add WordPress Plugin Check compliance fixes for translator comments, ordered placeholders, and escaped output.
  • Sanitize and unslash metabox inputs, remove deprecated translation loading, and add direct-access protection to the generated build config file.

0.1.6

  • Replace text-domain constants in translation calls with WP.org-compliant literal strings.
  • Normalize Tested up to metadata to 6.9 for plugin directory validation.

0.1.5

  • Add a “Get Plus” action link on free flavor installs.
  • Align plugin metadata, support links, and Plus upgrade URL override behavior.

0.1.4

  • Add robust Free/Plus conflict handling to prevent activation fatals.
  • Add a one-click admin action in Plus to deactivate the free plugin safely.
  • Update settings screen actions layout and footer branding.

0.1.3

  • Move uninstall cleanup to the Freemius after_uninstall hook for telemetry compatibility.
  • Verify and test against WordPress 6.9.1.

0.1.2

  • Tighten included post type handling to editorial and reviewable types.
  • Enforce a minimum review policy window of 7 days.
  • Hide Freemius upgrade UI when the local Plus override is active.

0.1.0

  • Add Freemius integration and Plus gating.
  • Refactor settings/query logic into separate traits.
  • Add build tooling and a test scaffold.

0.0.2

  • Make the plugin translation-ready and add a starter Spanish translation file.

0.0.1

  • Initial build.
